title: Android Wear Complication displays "Null, Null" with NSClient follower
symptom: When using xDrip+ as a Sync follower with NSClient app as local broadcaster, BG data displays on the phone app and on xDrip+ watchfaces, but the xDrip+ watch complication shows 'Null, Null'.
cause: The issue is likely in the code path when using NSClient with the phone in follower mode, which isn't populating the complication correctly. A workaround was found by gregorybel, but the root cause is not fully identified.
fix: A dirty workaround was provided by gregorybel in a branch, but no official fix is stated. Users are advised to update to the latest nightly and reinstall the watch app, but this did not resolve the issue for all.
evidence_quote: I expect that is the code path which isn't populating the complication correctly. I will check it out.
